adapter.output_policy: one adaptive history; built-in dense interpolation at five requested times; end stop-time

adapter.autodiff_policy: Rodas5P default AutoForwardDiff with supplied analytic state Jacobian; package may differentiate time dependence; Tsit5 uses no differentiation

adapter.step_cap_policy: package maxiters bounds total attempted steps
adapter.jit_policy: one complete same-request method/type/shape preparation solve per process; fresh measured problem/workspace/state/counters; preparation may fail and measured attempt still runs
